text:
clare.s: Heads-up: CeresBank POC incoming. Requirements from presales: IdP-initiated SAML for three apps, SCIM delta + group sync, Okta group->RBAC mapping (custom role names), delegated tenant admins, and tenant-level domain proofing across multiple subdomains. EU-only data residency. Need runbook + rough Hosted vs Dedicated pricing for next-week tech call.

yuval.k: I can take the runbook. Quick Q: expected SCIM burst rate or concurrent PATCHes? that'll change recommended plan.

maria.g: Sales intel: ~9k users, ~2.5k DAU, nightly full upsert, but heavy delta bursts during business hours (~3k ops/hour). They want near-realtime deltas and JIT SSO for some flows.

yuval.k: Good. For SAML we can emit multi-valued group claims and a custom claim name. Note: very large group lists can inflate assertion size; will add guidance to truncate/flatten. We don't auto-expand nested groups server-side; recommend IdP flattening or a short sync job.

maria.g: They specifically asked if wildcard/delegated domain verification is supported to speed tenant onboarding across brands (app.bank.ceres, payroll.bank.ceres).

yuval.k: GA product requires exact domain proof per tenant. Wildcard/delegated proofing is not GA. We can offer delegated proofing as an engineering SOW tied to Dedicated/Private deployments (est. 3-6 weeks dev + QA). Will mark as optional in the proposal.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Note: EU KMS key must be requested for region-residency. Also prepare standard security questionnaire answers re: SCIM data retention and access controls.

ymaria.g: Can Redwood map Okta groups -> SAML role claim and also feed the same mappings into SCIM group sync so role assignments remain consistent?

yuval.k: Yes. Attribute mapping supports group->role claim in the assertion and we persist group membership via SCIM groups. For nested groups we'll recommend flattening at the IdP or applying a small delta script during provisioning. I'll include example snippets in the runbook.

maria.g: They want a sample SCIM delta patch and a SAML metadata snippet for SRE + SSO team to test.

yuval.k: SCIM PATCH example (email replace):
```
curl -X PATCH "https://eu.api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users/5f2a" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails[primary eq true].value","value":"j.tester@ceres.bank"}]}'
```

SAML attribute snippet I'll add to runbook (short):
```
<Attribute Name="roles">
  <AttributeValue>payroll_admin</AttributeValue>
  <AttributeValue>compliance_viewer</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
```

pricing-bot: pricing-bot: provisional ballparks uploaded: https://redwood.s3/prequotes/ceresbank-hosted-v1.pdf

maria.g: Ballpark figures needed for call so Sales can keep momentum. Any quick topline?

pricing-bot: Off-the-record roughs (pre-sales, subject to PM/legal): Hosted (standard quotas) = ~€1.1k/mo; Hosted + SCIM quota bump = ~€2.7k/mo; Dedicated POC setup (one-time) = ~€20k; Dedicated recurring (reserved throughput) = ~€6.8k/mo. EU-region premium may apply.

clare.s: Plan: Yuval will produce runbook draft (SAML metadata exchange steps, SCIM delta replay, group-flatten guidance, delegated-admin test plan), Maria will attach security questionnaire answers and the provisional quote, and I'll schedule the tech call for Mon 09:00 CET and invite security + infra.

yuval.k: I'll upload runbook snippets to the shared drive and paste the link here once ready.

maria.g: Thanks team. keeping momentum :thumbsup:
